purpose: Teach: キルト/デッサン/ライフワーク/レインボー/ハヤカワ/ローソン/ベースボール/グリーンピース

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんがキルトをプレゼントして下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, Mei brought you a quilt as a gift.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact delivery. Opening note is gently present, a small smile in the voice. Unhurried — she's sharing something she knows will delight him. Slight upswing at the end, inviting his pleasure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとデッサン教室通いたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to take a drawing class with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, earnest request. Quick opening attack — he's been holding this thought and it tumbles out. Hopeful pitch on the final word. The simple directness of a child who doesn't yet know to temper his wants.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが研究をライフワークにされてるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your father has made his research his life's work.
lines.style: Gentle explanation, not dismissal. A touch wistful — she understands what he's asking for, even if she can't quite give it. Measured pace. The tone of someone explaining something tender about someone she loves.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとレインボーの絵描いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I painted a rainbow together.
lines.style: Quiet pride in his small voice. He's arriving at understanding something. The words come slower than before, weighted with meaning. Not bragging — sharing something he knows mattered.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがハヤカワ文庫を読んでらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was reading Hayakawa paperbacks.
lines.style: Observant, almost thinking aloud. A moment of connection she's witnessing — noting what his father does, who he is. Soft tone. The cadence of someone noticing the quiet moments that define a person.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとローソンに行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad took me to the convenience store.
lines.style: Simple delight. Short, factual sentence that somehow contains everything. A small laugh underneath. The wonder of ordinary moments with someone you love.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがベースボール観戦に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father said he'll take you to a baseball game.
lines.style: Warm delivery of good news. A small note of pride in her voice — his father is doing this. Slight rise at the end, inviting Sho's excitement. The tone of a mother passing along a gift from his father.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとグリーンピースの団体の話聞いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad told me about the Greenpeace organization.
lines.style: Earnest sharing of something learned. The words arrive with care — he's understood something bigger than himself and wants to tell her. Slight trailing at the end, opening the door for her response. The voice of a child reaching toward understanding.
